Wallpapers bundled in `app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/`, one per look. Each is a portrait crop
(1080×2340, WebP) of a work in the public domain, taken from Wikimedia Commons.

| File | Work | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wall_slate.webp` | James McNeill Whistler, *Nocturne in Black and Gold – The Falling Rocket*, c. 1875 | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Whistler-Nocturne_in_black_and_gold.jpg |
| `wall_paper.webp` | Hasegawa Tōhaku, *Pine Trees* (left screen), c. 1595 | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hasegawa_Tohaku_-_Pine_Trees_(Sh%C5%8Drin-zu_by%C5%8Dbu)_-_left_hand_screen.jpg |
| `wall_mono.webp` | Ansel Adams, *The Tetons and the Snake River*, 1942 (made for the US National Park Service) | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Adams_The_Tetons_and_the_Snake_River.jpg |
| `wall_night.webp` | James McNeill Whistler, *Nocturne: Blue and Gold – Southampton Water*, 1872 | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:James_McNeill_Whistler_-_Nocturne-_Blue_and_Gold--Southampton_Water_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg |
| `wall_bold.webp` | Katsushika Hokusai, *Fine Wind, Clear Morning*, c. 1831 | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Red_Fuji_southern_wind_clear_morning.jpg |
| `wall_quiet.webp` | Claude Monet, *Water Lilies*, 1906 (Art Institute of Chicago) | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Claude_Monet_-_Water_Lilies_-_1933.1157_-_Art_Institute_of_Chicago.jpg |
| `wall_dusk.webp` | Claude Monet, *The Houses of Parliament (Effect of Fog)*, 1903–04 (The Met, CC0) | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Houses_of_Parliament_(Effect_of_Fog)_MET_DT1893.jpg |
| `wall_ocean.webp` | Katsushika Hokusai, *The Great Wave off Kanagawa*, c. 1831 | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Great_Wave_off_Kanagawa2.jpg |
| `wall_dawn.webp` | J. M. W. Turner, *Norham Castle, Sunrise*, c. 1845 | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Joseph_Mallord_William_Turner_062.jpg |
